create_word_finder_regex: create a regex pattern that matches any of the provided words with word boundary delimiters
extract_snippets: extract variable-length multi-sentence snippets from C4 web text with abbreviation expansion pairs
reverse_substitution: conduct reverse substitution by swapping expansions for abbreviations in a snippet
sample_snippets_by_substitution: sample a fixed number of snippets for each abbreviation-expansion substitution pair
build_wsrs_features: build a WSRSFeatures dataclass instance storing original and abbreviated snippets
